approved_date.description: ISO date on which the Human Creative Authority approved this asset.

approved_by.description: Authority that granted approval. Must be 'human-creative-authority'.

items.title: PreservedMediaReference
items.description: A reference to one preserved medium (master or named derivative). INVARIANT 1: a sha256 establishes FILE IDENTITY, never approval. INVARIANT 2: delivery_status (governance) and storage_status (preservation) are independent facts; an APPROVED ASSET may legitimately read storage_status 'recorded-only' or 'preservation-incident'. INVARIANT 3: an approved media reference is immutable - a changed sha256 under the same id requires superseding the entry and appending to sha256_history, never an in-place edit.

id.description: Stable asset ID. The master and every derivative carry their own distinct id.

path.description: Canonical repository-relative path, or an explicit durable URI. Null when the medium is held externally.

durable_uri.description: Stable retrieval reference for externally stored media. Required when path is null.

present.description: Whether the bytes are currently retrievable from the designated store.

storage_status.description: preserved-retrievable = bytes held and checksum re-verifies; recorded-only = metadata only, retrieval impossible; preservation-incident = should exist but is absent.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes. Establishes identity on retrieval. Does NOT establish approval.

sha256_history.description: Append-only. Preserves prior checksums so a replaced file cannot silently retain the same identity.

decision_id.description: Canonical decision record that authorised this approval. Required for APPROVED ASSET.

superseded_by.description: Id of the media reference that replaced this one.

derivative_of.description: Provenance: stable asset id of the source medium. REQUIRED (non-empty string) when lineage == 'derivative'; must be null or absent when lineage == 'original'.

transformation.description: Provenance: the exact transformation applied to the source, sufficient to regenerate or audit the derivative (e.g. 'convert <master> -crop 1403x758+0+130 +repage <out>'). REQUIRED when lineage == 'derivative'; must be null or absent when lineage == 'original'.

lineage.description: R-1. Provenance is MANDATORY and explicit. 'original' = a genuinely original generation with no parent; declare it as an ORIGINAL ASSET rather than as a derivative with missing lineage. 'derivative' = a crop, edit, grade, reframe, or other transformation of another medium, and MUST name both derivative_of and transformation.

else.description: Non-approved media must not carry an approved_by field.

allOf.description: R-1: a derivative must name its source and its transformation.
R-1: an original asset declares no lineage rather than a derivative with missing parentage.

approved_media.description: Media promoted to, or recorded as, APPROVED ASSET. Each entry is independently identified.

candidate_media.description: Media not yet approved. Item schema is identical to approved_media (R-1 lineage, storage_status, approval authority, preservation coherence).

garment_spec_lock.title: DesignConstraintLock
garment_spec_lock.description: A HUMAN-AUTHORISED DESIGN CONSTRAINT. Records what a thing must look like. Must never be used to record a measurement or verification rule, and a verification rule must never be recorded here.

calibrated_heuristic.title: VerificationRule
calibrated_heuristic.description: A HUMAN-AUTHORISED VERIFICATION RULE. Records how conformance is measured. Must never be used to record a design constraint, and a design constraint must never be recorded here.

test_references.description: Paths to verification artefacts exercising this asset.

version_history.description: Append-only. Every schema change records version, date, rationale, compatibility assessment, and tests performed (R-6).

compatibility.description: Assessment against the versioning_policy: patch / minor / major, and against which baseline.

tests.description: Tests performed to validate the change.

media_disposition.description: Current PRODUCTION disposition of an asset's media, kept separate from its historical approval state. Exists so that a lost medium can be dispositioned without rewriting the approval record that preceded it.

historical_approval_retained.description: True when a prior approval remains on record as historical evidence and must not be rewritten to imply it never occurred.

approval_transfers_to_replacement.description: Must be false. A replacement requires its own verification and approval.

version_history.note: Initial Stage C asset schema (Stage C asset dependency map).
version_history.tests: Stage C registry validation across production/*.yaml.

version_history.note: Added optional approved_date, approved_by, approved_media, candidate_media, garment_spec_lock, calibrated_heuristic, test_references so promoted media could be registered with hash anchors.
version_history.compatibility: minor vs 0.2.0 - additions only, all optional

version_history.note: Hardened media references: required id/delivery_status/storage_status/sha256; sha256 pattern; storage_status enum; sha256_history and superseded_by; derivative_of and transformation; durable_uri, present, byte_length; additionalProperties false; APPROVED ASSET conditional requiring approved_by/approved_date/decision_id; mirror rule forbidding approved_by on unapproved media; external-storage conditional; preservation-state coherence conditionals; DesignConstraintLock and VerificationRule separated by const authority_type; schema_version and version_history added.
version_history.compatibility: minor vs 0.2.0 - assessed against the last RATIFIED version, since 0.3.0-draft was never in force. Newly added required fields apply only to newly added media-reference structures; no 0.2.0-valid record became invalid.
version_history.tests: schemas/tests/test-asset-schema.py: 21 checks, 0 failed (A1 backward compat over 51 entries, B1-B14 negative, C1-C6 positive, D1-D2 residual-risk probes).

version_history.note: R-1: mandatory derivative provenance via a required 'lineage' discriminator (original | derivative); a derivative must name derivative_of and transformation, an original must declare none. R-6: explicit semantic versioning policy for the schema contract, version_history entries now require version, date, note, compatibility and tests, and schema versioning is declared distinct from asset versioning. Added optional media_disposition block so a lost medium can be dispositioned without rewriting its prior approval.
version_history.compatibility: minor vs 0.2.0 - 'lineage' is required but applies only to media-reference structures introduced in this same unratified line, so no record that was valid under the last RATIFIED version (0.2.0) becomes invalid. Assessed against 0.2.0, not against the draft.
version_history.tests: schemas/tests/test-asset-schema.py: 31 checks, 0 failed (backward compat, B1-B18 negative incl. R-1 provenance cases, C1-C9 positive, D1-D2 residual risk, E1-E2 versioning policy).

versioning_policy.scheme: semantic versioning: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, with an optional -draft / -rcN pre-release suffix
versioning_policy.patch: Documentation or corrections that do not change validation behaviour. No new or removed constraints.
versioning_policy.minor: Backward-compatible additions that existing valid records can tolerate — new optional properties, new enum members where they widen, new conditionals that only constrain newly added fields.
versioning_policy.major: Breaking changes: new or removed mandatory fields that invalidate previously valid records, removed properties, narrowed types or enums, or a changed MEANING of an existing field.
versioning_policy.compatibility_baseline: Backward compatibility is assessed against the last RATIFIED version, not against an unratified draft. A draft or release candidate was never in force, so tightening it does not constitute a major change.
versioning_policy.distinct_from_asset_versioning: Schema versioning is separate from asset versioning. Changing the schema does not mean an approved image changed; changing an image does not mean the schema changed. Every asset carries its own 'version' field, which is unrelated to the schema's schema_version.
versioning_policy.required_record_per_change: Every schema change must record: version, date, rationale, compatibility assessment, and the tests performed.
versioning_policy.ratification: A version becomes canonical only on Human Creative Authority ratification. Pre-release suffixes (-draft, -rcN) mark versions that validate but are not yet canonical.

ratification_status.note: R-1 and R-6 are implemented. Ratification remains with the Human Creative Authority and is not self-granted.
